title: Merge Sorted Arrays
prompt: A reporting tool receives two sorted number lists and needs one sorted list. Write a function that merges both sorted arrays into a new sorted array.

explanation.beginner:
Example: mergeSortedArrays([1,3,5], [2,4]) produces [1,2,3,4,5]. State the comparison rule and tie behavior explicitly, and copy input before any in-place sort when the contract preserves it.

Compare “handles empty left arrays”: input [[],[1,2]] produces [1,2]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
State the comparison rule and tie behavior explicitly, and copy input before any in-place sort when the contract preserves it.

Tempting mistake: A boolean comparator is not a valid three-way numeric comparator. Equal keys also need a predictable tie policy.

The reference uses slice. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “handles empty left arrays”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
